title: Additive entity options, metadata and integration hooks
api_or_output: Approved additive XmlParseOptions properties, immutable document DTD metadata and internal entity/sink hooks

acceptance.description: Implement exact approved additive DtdProcessing/Resolver options, XmlDocumentType and document metadata storage, EntityUse/EntityExpansionRequest and IXmlEntityContext/IXmlDtdSink declarations, with narrow Common.cs and DomSink.cs partial modifiers and optional DOM metadata callback. No production entity/DOCTYPE parser or public stubs.

Verify approved API/nullability/defaults, immutable metadata/model lifetime and storage, option snapshot preservation, optional sink compatibility and unchanged existing event contract. Earlier strict parsing and DOM behavior remains passing; options/metadata model evidence must not claim working entity parsing.

Demonstrate actual additive API and metadata callback using only verified dependencies, record applicable owned allocation/performance boundaries and actual cumulative preservation checks at known revisions.

handoff.summary: Additive independently reviewable foundation before tightly coupled core/entity/source/default integration. Original parent acceptance remains unchanged.
requests: Common.cs change restricted to making existing sealed Limits-only XmlParseOptions partial, preserving defaults and metadata; DtdProcessing/Resolver additions in own XmlParseOptions.cs. Recover belongs later recovery.
DomSink.cs change restricted to partial modifier; optional IXmlDtdSink implementation belongs Tree/DtdMetadata/DomSink.Dtd.cs. No required IXmlEventSink callback/factory/adapter changes.
